steps.name: precheck-host-and-tables
command: SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, current_setting('shared_buffers') AS shared_buffers, current_setting('maintenance_work_mem') AS maintenance_work_mem; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_10k_rows FROM task68_spire_10k_load_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_100k_rows FROM task68_spire_100k_load_corpus; SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'ecaz'; SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE amname = 'ec_spire';

steps.name: create-10k-spire-topgraph-cache-index
command: SET client_min_messages TO notice; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_10k_load_turboquant_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_10k_profile_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_10k_drilldown_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_10k_fastpath_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_10k_topgraph_cache_idx; CREATE INDEX task68_spire_10k_topgraph_cache_idx ON task68_spire_10k_load_corpus USING ec_spire (embedding ecvector_spire_ip_ops) WITH (nlists = 32, recursive_fanout = 8, nprobe = 24, rerank_width = 25, storage_format = 'turboquant', boundary_replica_count = 0, top_graph_enabled = 1, top_graph_degree = 32, top_graph_build_list_size = 100, top_graph_search_list_size = 16);

steps.name: create-100k-spire-topgraph-cache-index
command: SET client_min_messages TO notice; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_100k_load_turboquant_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_100k_profile_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_100k_drilldown_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_100k_fastpath_idx; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task68_spire_100k_topgraph_cache_idx; CREATE INDEX task68_spire_100k_topgraph_cache_idx ON task68_spire_100k_load_corpus USING ec_spire (embedding ecvector_spire_ip_ops) WITH (nlists = 128, recursive_fanout = 8, nprobe = 24, rerank_width = 25, storage_format = 'turboquant', boundary_replica_count = 0, top_graph_enabled = 1, top_graph_degree = 32, top_graph_build_list_size = 100, top_graph_search_list_size = 16);
